question: A alone can complete a work in 10 days and B can complete it in 15 days. A and B undertake the work for Rs. 4,800. With the help of C, they complete the work in 5 days. What amount is to be paid to C?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to do a work = 10 days 

Time taken by B to do the same work = 15 days 

Time taken by A, B and C do the same work = 5 days

Amount of earning = Rs.4800 

**Formula used:**

Ratio of shares of A, B and C = Ratio of their Efficiency
